common_topics.label: Requested result and scope
common_topics.why: Recover the real outcome and dependent work.
questions: What concrete result must reach the named consumer in this scope?
decisions: Current result, exact consumer and stop
common_topics.applies_when: Use the current request and accepted requirements first.

common_topics.label: Project source and accepted decisions
common_topics.why: Keep the original lineage through any route.
questions: Which current project record controls the affected requirement or disputed choice?
decisions: Exact authoritative record and required carry-over
common_topics.applies_when: Use when several sources or stages appear relevant.

route.label: Sufficient route
route.why: Select the available owner and preserve the existing scope.
questions: Which verified route can return the requested result under the current host and permission limits?
decisions: Actual route, available capability and integrator
route.applies_when: Use for a material route decision with uncertain dependencies.

resume.label: Current state and unknown effects
resume.why: Reconcile a paused or interrupted task before a dependent action.
questions: Which actions have authoritative receipts and which still need reconciliation?
decisions: Current checkpoint and next permitted action
resume.applies_when: Use when resuming after interruption, pause, changed source or missing receipt.

handoff.label: Handoff and return
handoff.why: Give the next consumer enough authority, inputs and evidence to act.
questions: What scope, exact sources, due acceptance and return evidence belong in this handoff?
decisions: Handoff target, input and result pins, permitted effects and return route
handoff.applies_when: Use when a task crosses an actor or environment.
